$comment: Generated by `mwops release write-rights-files` from package.json and model-card.json. Edit the generator or those files, never this one.
version_series_meaning: This package ships a model graph, and model_card_version names the trained model. It is a different series from package_version, which moves in lockstep across every mailwoman workspace on every release. `mwops release verify-metadata` keys the score ledger and release documentation off this number.

model_graph.summary: The model accepts tokenized text and emits logits float32[1, sequence, 33] and locale_logits float32[1, 9] and address_system_logits float32[1, 42]. It has no supported text-generating output.

entries.text: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL-1.0): the training extracts of the 100 ODbL sources of corpus v0.7.10-gb-county, the per-country `osm-*` extracts read from Geofabrik extracts (the 2026-10-02 extracts for RU, IN, ID, NG, PK, VN and BD, and the 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17 extracts for the countries added in #2663 and #2665), the `rendered-pk-register` and `rendered-bd-register` extracts rendered from OSM tuples, and the 49,219 `spliced-sub-venue` rows that carry an OpenStreetMap venue or sub-venue name. © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Corpus v0.8.21-retention-overlay reads v0.8.18's osm extracts, which render 30% of the osm sources' rows with a trailing country name. The extracts are Derivative Databases under ODbL 1.0, the effective training manifest packages/corpus/data/training-manifests/v0.8.21-retention-overlay.effective.json records what reached the trainer, and they are published under ODbL 1.0 at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sister-software/mailwoman-osm-training-extract.
LINZ-derived OpenAddresses NZ (CC-BY 4.0): the `synth-nz-v2` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0.
OpenAddresses ES tuples (CC-BY per OA source): the `synth-es-pedania-v1` training extract (800,000 rows, below-municipio pedanía place names) NEW in 6.7.0.

BAN — Base Adresse Nationale (DINUM / IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0): the `synth-fr-lieudit-v1` training extract (`nom_ld` lieu-dit field) NEW in 6.7.0, additional to the existing `synth-fr-fragment` extract (144,865 rows, 6.4.0).

Overture Maps Foundation — Addresses theme (per-country register license; Overture declares no identifier of its own for this theme, so the terms are the upstream register's): the `overture-latam` CA/MX training extract (456,230 rows, 6.6.0). Attribution-only, not share-alike. Read 2026-09-25 from https://docs.overturemaps.org/attribution/.
OpenAddresses CZ — ČÚZK RÚIAN (CC-BY 4.0): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-cz coord eval sets
OpenAddresses PL — GUGiK / PRG (public, BDOT-derived): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-pl coord eval sets
OpenAddresses SK — MINV/ZBGIS (CC-0/CC-BY per OA source): oa-sk coord eval set (free-rider validation)
OpenAddresses SI — GURS (CC-BY per OA source): oa-si coord eval set (free-rider validation)
See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the standing OpenAddresses / GeoNames / WOF attribution.

data_access_offers.statement: The OpenStreetMap-derived training extracts of corpus v0.8.21-retention-overlay, © OpenStreetMap contributors. Corpus v0.8.21 reads its osm sources from the v0.8.18 overlay's parquet files, and each of its 102 ODbL sources holds the row count its v0.8.18 frozen record states, so the extracts are v0.8.18's: the 101 parquet files of the osm sources under data-v0.8.18/ (2,931,896 rows, 30% of them rendered with a trailing English country name), and the files of spliced-sub-venue, rendered-bd-register and rendered-pk-register under data/, which v0.8.18 holds unchanged from v0.7.10-gb-county. The dataset's MANIFEST.json at the revision named above lists every file with its sha256 and names model 10.8.0, trained on the same extracts, under produced_works.
